title: No first-rounder, no problem? Broncos out of Round 1 for the third time in five drafts

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: No first-rounder, no problem? Broncos out of Round 1 for the third time in five drafts
sources.description: The Jaylen Waddle trade leaves the Broncos in a familiar position, but the past two drafts without a Round 1 pick didn't go so bad.
